overview_description.description:
Sundeck is a data infrastructure and analytics company that rewrites, rejects, reroutes, and enhances your snowflake queries.

Sundeck executes pre- and post-hook SQL no matter what BI, notebook, or AI tool is used. They customize snowflakes to work the way you need them to work. They unleash creativity while also enhancing control. 

Founded by Jacques Nadeau in 2022 and is located in Santa Clara, California.

about_short_description.short_description: Sundeck is a data infrastructure and analytics company that rewrites, rejects, reroutes, and enhances your snowflake queries.

product.name: Query Engineering Platform
product.description: A platform that allows data engineers to optimize, govern, secure, and enhance Snowflake queries through customization and control.

product.name: OpsCenter
product.description: A Snowflake Native App for optimizing warehouse usage, understanding utilization patterns, and categorizing costs by workload.

product.name: Flows
product.description: Enables creation and management of query flows, allowing for independent modification and logic definition per flow.

product.name: Hooks
product.description: Tools within flows that inspect and modify queries before and after submission to Snowflake, including rerouting or rejecting queries.

product.name: Conditions
product.description: Configurations within hooks that target queries based on properties like SQL shape, user, and warehouse, to customize behavior.

product.name: SQL Management
product.description: Features for managing, understanding, and enhancing SQL through Sundeck, including adding new syntax and macros.
